title: Space x Aero Day
description: Beyond the horizon — a full day uniting aviation and space exploration, with talks, demos and challenges.

title: Interactive Games
description: Aerospace quiz competitions, drone racing gates and flight-simulator challenges — learning that feels like play.
alt: Members competing in an aerospace quiz and flight simulator challenge

title: Hands-on Workshops
description: CAD, aerodynamics, embedded electronics and drone building — practical skills, taught member to member.
alt: Members building drones and working on CAD models in the lab

title: Collaboration with Forum Club
description: Bringing aerospace companies to campus through career forums — meet the industry before you graduate.
alt: Aerospace careers forum with industry stands

title: Aerospace Movie Nights
description: Documentaries and classics of flight and space, popcorn included — the relaxed side of the club.
alt: Members watching an aerospace documentary together

title: Observation Nights
description: The club telescope comes out and the campus terrace becomes an observatory — planets, star maps and quiet wonder.
alt: Members observing the night sky with the club telescope
